facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2014-0113 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 23 June 2014 as a scheduled change under change request; no event precedes it in the record. The change request record covers 4 clauses across 2 controlled documents. The intent is to introduce a duty the documents in scope did not previously carry. The record reached the state dispositioned in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are PRO-HSE-005 and STD-HTW-004.
